title: Rust edge protocol parser audit adapter

must_satisfy.description: Every modbus decoder branch matches a documented function code in sensorprotocols/modbus.md
MQTT publish-side calls declare QoS explicitly (no implicit QoS=0 in production paths)
I2C addresses do not collide across compiled-in driver modules
Atlas EZO command strings match the documented EZO command reference
LoRaWAN session keys are not logged or persisted in plaintext outside the secure-element store

title: NATS topic ACL + cert-CN identity adapter

must_satisfy.description: Every service in infrastructure/nats/services.yaml has a matching cert CN entry in the GENERATED block of nats.conf
nats.conf authorization.users[] is bounded by # BEGIN/END GENERATED sentinels and contains no hand-edits
No service references password: or $NATS_*_USER/PASS variable substitution (ADR-015)
Every topic publish/subscribe in libs/backend-common/src/nats/ has a corresponding ACL grant in services.yaml

title: GraphQL security guards adapter (depth + complexity + introspection)

must_satisfy.description: Every GraphQL endpoint declares a depth limit (≤10 default)
Every GraphQL endpoint declares a complexity limit (≤1000 cost units default)
Introspection is disabled in production builds (NODE_ENV=production)
Mutation resolvers carry @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, TenantGuard) explicit annotations

title: GDPR operations adapter (erasure + consent + PII masking)

must_satisfy.description: Every service holding tenant data implements eraseTenantData(tenantId, {dryRun}) honoring legal_hold precedence
ConsentService logs consent grants/revocations to shared.user_consents with grant_id + version
StructuredLoggerService.maskPii() is applied on every log path touching user PII
Retention policies are declared via @RetentionPolicy(days, classification) entity decorator
Every webhook handler calls stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(rawBody, signature, secret) before any business logic
Idempotency key is recorded in billing.stripe_webhook_events with UNIQUE constraint
Raw body is preserved (Buffer, not parsed JSON) for signature verification
Replay window enforced via tolerance=300 (5 min) on Stripe.Webhook.constructEvent

title: AI service guardrails adapter (prompt injection + cost caps)

must_satisfy.description: Every prompt assembly path runs through PromptInjectionFilter before LLM call
Every tool execution requires a tenant-scoped tool-whitelist lookup
Per-tenant cost cap (CostMeteringService.reserve()) is checked BEFORE LLM call
User PII is masked via maskPii() before insertion into prompt
Context window budget gate enforced (≤80% of model max)

title: Module Federation remote integrity adapter (SRI + version pinning)

must_satisfy.description: Every Module Federation remote URL carries a Subresource Integrity hash
Remote version is explicitly pinned (no `latest` or `*` references)
Remote URLs target only allowlisted CDN domains
Fallback chain on remote load failure is bounded (≤2 fallbacks)

title: Docker container security adapter (non-root + healthcheck + base pin)

must_satisfy.description: Every Dockerfile declares USER <non-root> before CMD/ENTRYPOINT
Every production Dockerfile carries a HEALTHCHECK directive
FROM lines pin base image to a SHA digest (not `:latest` tag)
Secrets are mounted via --secret or BuildKit secrets, not ENV

title: Database index coverage + N+1 detection adapter

must_satisfy.description: Every foreign key column has a corresponding index
Repository find() calls in loops are flagged as potential N+1
WHERE-clause column combinations with cardinality >10k have composite indexes
UNIQUE constraints declared in entities match the migration schema
